messages:
Alex Kim: quick heads-up — setting up a short shadowing loop this week. Mira starts Thursday night. Need to lock primary/secondary for Thu 22:00 UTC -> Fri 08:00 UTC and Fri 22:00 UTC -> Sat 08:00 UTC. Also want to double-check the overnight coverage gap we saw last month.

Mira Patel: hey all, excited to shadow. what should I expect operationally? a bit nervous about being paged into something i don't know yet 😅

Alex Kim: totally fine — you'll be paired shadowing, not thrown in cold. expectations: watch alerts, follow the triage checklist, observe escalations. if you see a P1 or customer-impacting alert, call the pager and escalate per runbook. quick triage pointer: https://intranet.redwood/ops/runbooks/oncall

Alex Kim: pasted a short cheat for the handover so you have something to reference during the night: 
```
- check new alerts: /alerts -> filter inference.*
- verify latency/5xx: /metrics?service=inference (10m, 1m)
- backend timeouts -> restart queue-worker: kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/queue-worker
- networking errors -> escalate to eng-sre pager
- if KV errors (cache): flush and notify eng-db
```

OncallBot: :bell: ALERT routed to primary (Jon S.) — inference-frontend 5xx spike (10m avg > 3%) — alert id A-78421 — thread created in #eng-oncall

Jon S.: available to be primary Thu night. I can take 22:00-02:00 and cover initial window. @Sophie Chen can you be my secondary for Thu? @Taylor can you take Fri primary?

Sophie Chen: yep I can be secondary Thu. reachable by phone if needed :phone: 

Taylor: I can take Fri primary. I can also pick up 03:30-05:00 UTC if we want to split the long overnight.

Alex Kim: there's a known coverage gap historically between 02:00-05:00 UTC Fri that caused missed pages. proposal:
- Jon S.: primary 22:00-02:00
- Mira Patel: shadow & cover 02:00-03:30 (take active watch, not full ownership)
- Taylor: primary 03:30-08:00

Mira Patel: I can do 02:00-03:30 but would prefer a live handover with Jon at 02:00 so he can walk me through active alerts and any ongoing work.

Jon S.: yep, I'll do a 10-15m handover at 02:00 and share my screen for active alerts and recent deploys. Mira — bring a laptop, we'll use Zoom + shared terminal. :computer:

Alex Kim: escalation thresholds (also in runbook) to watch:
- customer visible: >5% 5xx or >30% latency increase over baseline -> open incident ticket and notify @oncall-leads
- degraded but not customer impacting -> keep in-channel, increase polling cadence
- stateful store errors (redis/db) -> immediate escalation to eng-db pager

Sophie Chen: small checklist for shadows before taking an active slot: run local smoke check 
`curl -s https://inference-api.redwood/health | jq .`
if status != ok, file a quick incident and ping primary immediately.

OncallBot: :memo: New on-call onboarding checklist assigned to Mira Patel — steps 1..8 — due before first shadow shift. Link: https://intranet.redwood/ops/oncall-onboarding

Alex Kim: also, here's the one-off roster command to add the temporary coverage override (we'll commit this to the shared rota repo):
```
# add a one-off coverage override
roster add --name "Mira Patel" --start 2026-03-19T02:00Z --end 2026-03-19T03:30Z --notes "shadow handover"
```

Taylor: FYI in past incidents the usual quick mitigation was scaling frontend replicas + clearing KV cache. mitigation steps are under runbook -> "mitigations -> 5xx spike". Mira I'll walk you through those during the handover.

Mira Patel: thank you — quick question: do we have a simple customer impact assessment checklist? how do we decide when to mark an incident as "customer visible" and trigger the status page?

Alex Kim: short decision guide:
- check downstream SLA dashboards and customer error reports
- if >10 unique customer-facing errors in 30m -> open P1, update status page
- create incident ticket with summary, impact, mitigations, and next steps
- use incident template: https://intranet.redwood/incidents/template

Jon S.: note re: paging etiquette — if you get paged and can't reply within 5m, escalate to secondary. acknowledge pages even if you hand off quickly; don't leave a page unack'd.

Sophie Chen: reminder: phone escalation and quiet-hours policies are in the handbook. new shadows should read sections 2-4 and sign off on the checklist.

Alex Kim: roster updated per plan. Handover scheduled at 02:00 UTC Fri (Jon -> Mira). Mira will shadow until 03:30, then Taylor picks up. I'll sit in the handover call to help with any live escalations. :headphones:

Mira Patel: thanks everyone — appreciate the walkthrough. see you Thursday night 🙌

OncallBot: :white_check_mark: Thread closed. Onboarding checklist progress: steps 1-3 complete for Mira. Reminder scheduled: 24h before shift.
